sources.primary_title: Tencent Cloud Partners with Logistics Platform TruKKer in Saudi Amid Regional Expansion
sources.verified_angle_summary: Tencent Cloud has announced a strategic partnership with TruKKer, the MENA region's largest digital freight network, ahead of LEAP 2026. TruKKer will migrate its logistics platform to Tencent Cloud's Saudi Arabia region and adopt CodeBuddy, Tencent's AI-powered coding assistant, to enhance DevOps operations. The partnership coincides with Tencent's global rollout of its Hy3 AI model and builds on its ongoing investment in the region, including a $150 million commitment and obtaining the Class C License from Saudi Arabia's CST. This is a concrete cloud migration and AI adoption deal for Tencent's local infrastructure. The story is distinct and verified across official press releases and reputable IT media.
sources.verified_key_facts: TruKKer is migrating its logistics platform to Tencent Cloud's Saudi Arabia region; TruKKer will adopt Tencent's AI-powered coding assistant, CodeBuddy; Tencent Cloud obtained Class C License from Saudi Arabia's CST; Tencent announced a $150 million investment commitment in its Saudi cloud region in 2025; Tencent recently launched its Hy3 AI model globally; TruKKer is MENA's largest digital freight network.
